artists.biography: Neneh Mariann Cherry (born Neneh Mariann Karlsson; 10 March 1964) is a Swedish singer-songwriter, rapper, and occasional DJ and broadcaster. Blending hip hop with other influences, Cherry experienced mainstream success with several of her recordings.

perplexity.description:
Neneh Cherry’s debut album Raw Like Sushi, released in 1989 on Virgin Records, is a genre-blurring landmark that fuses electronic, hip hop, funk, and soul into a vibrant and innovative sound. Drawing from Cherry’s diverse background and her immersion in London’s multicultural music scene, the album features a dynamic mix of rap, dance, and pop elements, anchored by her distinctive voice and charismatic delivery. Tracks like the hit single “Buffalo Stance” showcase her ability to blend go-go rhythms with rap and pop sensibilities, while songs such as “Kisses On The Wind” and “Inna City Mamma” highlight her lyrical wit and genre-hopping production, which incorporates scratching, sampling, and multilingual lyrics.

Raw Like Sushi stands as a pivotal release in Neneh Cherry’s discography, launching her solo career after earlier work with artists like The The and Massive Attack. The album was both a critical and commercial success, peaking at number two on the UK Albums Chart and achieving international acclaim. Its collaborative spirit and genre experimentation helped presage the creative directions of 1990s electronica and alternative pop, cementing Cherry’s reputation as a pioneering artist unafraid to defy categorization. The album’s legacy endures as a bold, authentic statement from a singular voice in contemporary music.
